extras: Users must trust the content of notebooks, as they can execute code and write files to the vault.
intentEvidence: Obsidian plugin that renders marimo cells as live, reactive WASM islands inside notes.
problem: Users need a way to execute and visualize live, reactive Python code directly within their Markdown notes without setting up a local Python environment or external server.

relations.evidence: Built on marimo islands, the same runtime behind marimo-anywhere

summary: Marimo Notes renders marimo notebooks as live, reactive Python cells within Obsidian notes using in-browser Pyodide, eliminating the need for a local Python installation.
